<observations>
Date: Mar 2, 2026
* 🔴 (07:30) User stated they are building Ledgerly, a TypeScript invoicing SaaS targeting freelancers in Canada.
* 🔴 (21:30) User named primary database schema `ledgerly_core`. Teammate Priyanka Vashisht reviews DB migrations. Prefers VSCode extensions for linting.
* ✅ (16:40) Initial codebase compiled; PDF generation implemented using PDFKit (v0.13.0) and tested with Jest (`src/invoice/render.test.ts`).

Date: Mar 5, 2026
* 🔴 (07:45) User added JWT auth and automatic version bumping via `standard-version`.
* ✅ (14:30) Configured GitHub Actions CI (`.github/workflows/ci.yml`), Stripe payment integration placeholder (`src/payments/stripe.ts`), and release script.

Date: Mar 8, 2026
* 🔴 (07:10) User integrated audit logging to Loggly via Winston (aiming for >= 85% test coverage).
* ✅ (12:30) Jest configured for coverage (achieved 87%); Winston logger with Loggly transport tested and committed to `audit/logging`.

Date: Mar 11, 2026
* 🔴 (12:45) User exposed GET `/invoices/:id/pdf` with QR code support (`qrcode` v1.5.2). Production Postgres runs in Frankfurt.
* ✅ (16:00) Merged PDF generation branch, added Prometheus metrics middleware (`src/middleware/metrics.ts`), and updated README.

Date: Mar 15, 2026
* 🔴 (14:00) User requested Docker containerization for staging.
* ✅ (16:40) Added Nodemailer email notifications with Handlebars templates (`templates/invoiceEmail.hbs`), containerized app with Docker, and pushed `v1.3.0-staging` image to GHCR.

Date: Mar 19, 2026
* 🔴 (16:05) User stated preference for `pnpm` over `npm` for all package installation commands.
* 🟡 (15:30) Added `express-rate-limit` middleware to PDF download endpoint.
* ✅ (14:00) Installed Cypress E2E testing, added Sentry error tracking (`src/monitoring/sentry.ts`), and created health-check endpoint (`src/routes/health.ts`).
</observations>

<current-task>
- Primary: Waiting for user to report on end-to-end testing results (scheduled to begin after Mar 19).
</current-task>

<suggested-response>
The assistant should wait for the user to provide feedback on the end-to-end testing or specify the next feature/bugfix to work on.
</suggested-response>
